preconditions.description: The input contains at least one line for the number of test cases.
The first line contains a valid integer t representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 200000 for n in [int(lines[i].strip()) for i in range(1, len(lines), 2)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the array length n is between 1 and 2*10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in [int(x) for x in lines[i+1].split()]) for i in range(1, len(lines), 2))
preconditions.description: For each test case, all array elements are integers between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: sum(int(lines[i].strip()) for i in range(1, len(lines), 2)) <= 200000
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_lines[k] == str(max([sum([a[j] for j in [i, i+a[i], i+a[i]+a[i+a[i]], ...] if j < n]) for i in range(n)])) for k in range(t))
postconditions.description: Each output line is the maximum score achievable by choosing an optimal starting index, where the score is the sum of elements visited by repeatedly jumping a[i] positions to the right until the index exceeds n.
